_source.how: docker run --rm --network none IMAGE awk PROGRAM, one run per case (busybox:1.25 as linux/amd64 under emulation, the docker warning about it left out)
_source.what: mawk names every clash of a name used as an array and as a scalar, up to five; BusyBox takes for ((k) in a) and stops at delete a[1], a[2] with Not an array
